prompts.task:
Copy genai-default-audit.json into canonical .observe/otel-audit.json, validate it and select exactly OTEL-001 through the bundled selection flow as plan scope context. Keep AO work unselected and make no live application closure claim from this focused supplemental assessment. Assess only the independent supplied decorator/source/probe, dependency-policy and native-signal cases in genai-instrument-decorator-profile-evidence.json. Write .observe/genai-instrument-decorator-profile-plan.md as a supplemental plan; the live OTEL-001 selection is scope context, and no dependency application or AO resource/config change is selected. Start with an addressable case inventory: function_cases, every local_probe.observations entry, version_policy_cases and studio_signal_cases. Equivalent grouped sections are fine only when every distinct child decision/assertion can be located.

For every function_cases entry and every individually addressable local_probe.observations entry, use dated SDK/converter/helper source and native capture facts to choose a current producer/decorator pattern and supported route, or an exact justified fallback. Record the known function/span_type/native-node mapping only where supplied. For probe-only method_result, nested_result, finite_generator, async_result, async_generator and cancel_exception, do not borrow another function case or invent a captured function, operation/span_type, receiver/complete arguments, node IDs/counts or sink identity: state each actual missing identity explicitly, choose the supported decorator pattern or exact contract-based fallback that the supplied shape permits, and hold actual typed creation/application unproven until source mapping exists. Unknown typed identity does not excuse an omitted per-observation decision or a grouped future promise. Each entry must retain its actual observed safe value, ordered yields or re-raised error/cancellation, explain business protocol/outcome and field/limit/sink availability, and name concrete future source-mapping, result/argument, parent/count and terminal/lifecycle acceptance assertions. Prefer supported public SDK @log for compatible safe bounded function shapes and ordinary finite sync/async iteration; preserve existing wrapper ownership. An application-owned function decorator around a documented public creator needs an exact applicable source/capture/privacy/protocol/sink incompatibility. Generic unproven completeness or source-unavailable metadata alone is not that incompatibility; keep those gaps explicit without claiming complete native/wire semantics. For known function cases, make the current decision from the supplied bounds, operation and converter facts, rather than deferring it to a conditional future preference. For safe-sync-tool, explicitly apply the supplied converter fact that native tool argument/result capture omits required same-tool input/output messages. Safe bounded arguments establish native @log dispatch support, not full-profile support. Resolve this known applicable mapping gap now with a source-supported public same-operation route: documented same-span enrichment only when its actual SDK registration boundary is evidenced, otherwise an application-owned function decorator invoking the documented writable-span helper with the required mappings on that same operation. A generic future possible enrichment or OpenInference alternative without an evidenced public emission/registration path is not resolution; do not add a duplicate operation or declare the known gap absent. Preserve SDK @log preference for other safe source cases unless their own concrete applicable incompatibility is shown.

Record exact official example path/revision and the actions actually exercised in its supplied source snapshot. Distinguish official_sdk_examples.files snapshots/receipts from guide-linked examples whose source was not supplied or inspected: do not attach the snapshot receipt revision/date or claim exercised calls for an uncaptured path merely because the guide links it. A guide-linked proposed example remains explicitly uninspected unless an independent dated source check is actually available. Keep logger-example calls, separately documented logger API signatures/lifecycle methods, decorator source and public-helper source/import/signature as distinct provenance; do not claim a logger example exercises the helper.

For each justified application-owned helper fallback, select the intended public OTel provider/registration/processor/exporter and lifecycle route in this plan now, rather than only promising to name it during future verification. Name the documented public imports/interfaces, provider ownership and initialization before first helper use, public processor/exporter registration and intended runtime trace destination/profile, source-side sanitized setters/finalizer behavior on the same yielded span, and owned flush/shutdown through that same provider. For an independently required custom exporter whose actual instance/class is not supplied, explicitly mark that identity unavailable and name the proposed documented interface/ownership/registration route without inventing a captured instance. Distinguish this application-provider helper route from the SDK-owned standalone @log sink, which an unrelated global provider does not configure. Disclose the supplied helper source limits: start_as_current_span receives only the name, so creation kind is INTERNAL and initial semantic attributes are absent; post-yield/finally attribute enrichment or a completed-export view does not prove creation-time sampling/on_start semantics or repair a required CLIENT kind. Do not invent unsupported helper kind/attribute arguments, mutate private cached provider state or duplicate nodes. Exact actual compatible dependency graph, provider/export binding, any required unavailable creator capability, runtime and receiver remain Not proven; named proposed public components are an implementation plan, not installed/executed support.

Evaluate all fictional version policy cases from their candidate facts, keeping actual project SDK/exporter/logging bridge resolution unproven where metadata/solver evidence is absent. Future application must use a coherent checked graph/specs or lockfile with no unresolved placeholders or floating re-resolution. Evaluate all native signal/profile cases field by field, then separately plan normal actual-application logging acceptance and explicit opt-out/misconfiguration branches. Read actual app.py logger callsites and the existing launch identity; bind normal acceptance to a chosen source-backed body, severity, callsite/logger scope and service resource, or an exact reason a requested field is unavailable. Synthetic packet body/severity/service values cannot substitute for actual application fields. Specify the proposed consumed profile exporter, complete local logs endpoint and matching protocol explicitly for the supplied synthetic HTTP profiles, while keeping actual receiver discovery/resolution unavailable where not performed. For the real future application, require actual same-namespace local endpoint resolution and matching transport before launch rather than claiming a live receiver from the synthetic profile. Require exactly one bounded safe native LogRecord per chosen application call, preserved original sink, future correlation with the actual owning span, separate log-provider/bridge drain/close and independent trace/metric receipts; current matching span IDs are not supplied and must not be invented. Distinguish SDK operation spans from application LogRecords, safe native fields from matched owning-span correlation, and synthetic packets from actual receiver/runtime/cloud proof. Preserve existing source business values, original local logging sinks, unrelated trace/metric paths and supported consumers. For error-after-produced-partial-native-capture and its failed_generator observations, preserve the actual produced partial content through a supported safe GenAI/OpenInference representation on the same owning operation while retaining ERROR and the real exception. An ERROR result does not authorize blanket deletion of produced output or replacing it with an empty value; do not present partial content as successful final completion, fabricate unseen output or invent unavailable generation slots/positions. Keep observed output, exception and current source finalizer loss separate from future repair/emission proof.

This is plan-only: preserve application, dependency, configuration, test and input files; do not install packages, start services, call models/cloud, provision resources, or claim implementation/runtime/receiver success. Use files, terminal and structured APIs only; do not open or operate browsers, Computer Use or other UI. Save artifacts without opening tabs.

judge_inputs: Return exactly 6 checks, one for each criterion in the exact original order, with IDs rubric-1, rubric-2, rubric-3, rubric-4, rubric-5, rubric-6. No omitted, merged, duplicated or shifted criteria. Assess each independently; do not combine adjacent metadata/finish criteria. Reject incomplete grade coverage instead of treating a smaller check count as a passing result.

Read .observe/genai-instrument-decorator-profile-plan.md and any linked equivalent report evidence, service/eval/inputs/genai-instrument-decorator-profile-evidence.json, last_message.md and grade.json. Facts include eleven function cases, every native probe observation, three fictional version cases and three native signal cases; no specific JSON row format is required.

The fictional newest compatible example-genai-sdk is 1.1 for Python3.12; 2.0 requires3.13 and 1.0 is older. This is an evaluation answer, not a live package fact. Actual source/probe versions do not provide a complete project/exporter/bridge solver graph. Require exact immutable later application while accepting missing actual metadata explicitly.

The normal log plan requires actual safe body/severity/shared resource/source-context or exact absence reasons and future owning-span correlation, original local sink retention, exactly-one LogRecord, owned log drain/close and separate traces/metric receipt. The supplied native log IDs have correct nonzero field shape, but its trace example has no IDs proving a match; synthetic fields never close actual receiver or cloud proof. Preserve opt-out zero-record and misconfiguration isolation as separate branches.

Probe-only function/type, receiver, full method arguments and native node IDs/counts are not all supplied. Do not demand invented captured values; require explicit availability plus concrete planned assertions and producer/fallback decisions. Preserve actual supplied ordered values/errors and real source limits.
rubric: For every independently supplied supported safe finite sync/async function, bound method, nested distinct operation and plain finite sync/async iteration case, plans the SDK @log decorator pattern with the correct actual span_type/function and supported public configuration. Preserves already captured provider/framework operations without duplicate model/tool decorators and existing valid producers. Separately assesses the supplied native decorator limits: mapped input still exposes originals, variadic binding can omit arguments, generator send/throw/asend/athrow or unbounded aggregation may change the contract, successful null/error/partial output may be invalid or lost, and an ingestion hook or unrelated global provider is not a public same-record exporter hook. Chooses a supported application-owned function decorator invoking the documented chosen SDK creator for exact incompatible cases at the same operation, without duplicate spans, private SDK patches, raw capture or changed business values/errors/stream protocol. Does not reject all async generators or claim every @log operation is current-semantic complete from dispatch alone; actual source/probe facts remain separate from live app/OTLP/cloud proof. Reconciles supported surfaces visible only in the supplied native local_probe observations with function_cases: enumerate bound-method receiver/argument/result behavior and nested distinct operation parentage/counts as separate decisions and acceptance assertions. A grouped sync/async category does not prove either surface; one observed child operation is not a duplicate of its parent, while an extra wrapper around an already-produced operation is. Each probe-only sync/async/method/nested/finite-iteration/send/asend/cancellation surface has its own known observation, producer/fallback decision and concrete acceptance assertion. Equivalent grouped sections are accepted when every child is individually addressable; generic future own-operation promises fail. Missing actual function/type identities, receiver identities, complete method arguments, native node IDs/counts or terminal OTel fields must be explicitly unavailable, with planned future checks rather than invented capture proof. Preserve observed results/ordered yielded values/re-raised cancellation, and distinguish measured send/asend loss from unexecuted throw/athrow. Apply the supplied converter omission of same-tool input/output messages to safe-sync-tool and the supplied two-yield bound/ordinary-exhaustion consumer to finite-yielding-agent, with concrete current-source decisions rather than conditional future policy. Equivalent grouped evidence is valid only when every distinct case decision is addressable.

Assesses every local_probe.observations entry as an individually addressable observed value plus chosen creator/fallback and concrete future acceptance: mapped_input_return, method_result=5, successful_null_result, variadic_result=6, nested_result, finite_generator ordered first/second, send_protocol, failed_generator_first/exception, async_result=8, async_generator ordered async first/async second, asend_protocol and cancel_exception. Bound-method receiver exclusion/argument/result behavior and nested distinct-operation count/parentage are future assertions when actual receiver/arguments/native IDs/counts are not supplied. Missing function/span-type/receiver identities or terminal OTel fields stay explicitly unavailable; no invented measurement. Preserves yielded values and reraised cancellation, and separates ordinary iteration from send/asend and unexecuted throw/athrow.

Precisely handles the supplied measured mapped-input raw sentinel, incomplete variadic capture, successful-null-to-empty, produced-partial-to-empty error finalization and send/asend loss/unbounded retention. Keeps source-known source-side privacy and full business/error/protocol preservation before any SDK; redacted companion or post-export rewrite is not suppression. Selects only a documented public same-operation repair/application-owned function decorator fallback for its exact limitation, without duplicate spans or private sink mutation. Native schema ingestion_hook capture and SDK-owned sink differ from app global provider/exporter hooks; normal standalone routing is not universally blocked by a custom sink requirement. Explicit bounded limits, null-versus-no-result, parent lifetime and precise partial unsupported fields remain, with no blanket complete SDK/app/wire pass.

Applies the independently fictional dependency-policy cases through scoped candidate selection using their supplied compatibility facts. Separately requires actual task-time latest-compatible resolution using official package metadata/project resolver and runtime, peer, API and existing lock constraints together before dependency application. Selects the newest compatible supported candidate set, identifies why an incompatible newer set cannot be used, preserves a source-constrained compatible existing installation or explicit supported choice with its reason, and does not force an unrelated runtime upgrade or mix independently latest packages. Keeps all fixed library release recipes and historical thresholds out of shipped skill guidance, while recording the exact chosen versions/source/date and needed compatibility/import tests in run evidence and app manifest/lock plans. Distinguishes actual dated registry/SDK receipts, fictional policy evidence, unavailable live freshness, proposed versions and observed installation; never treats a previous captured main commit as fresh future latest. When the supplied compatibility facts already suffice, makes and validates the scoped candidate decision in this report instead of postponing it until implementation. A general latest-compatible policy or promise to run a future resolver leaves the supplied selection unresolved; the positive compatible candidate and the newer runtime-incompatible counterexample need explicit, separate reasons without claiming a live package exists. When a checked SDK/exporter/bridge candidate graph or lockfile is supplied or actually acquired, binds proposed application to exactly that set; never re-resolves a mutable latest tag after preflight. This fixture provides no complete actual project/exporter/log-bridge graph: explicitly unresolved components and missing-metadata/solver reasons are truthful plan output, not a failure to choose supplied fictional candidates. Historical probe versions cannot establish that missing graph; invented actual candidates or installation proof fail. Before later authorized dependency application, the plan requires coherent resolution under runtime/peer/API/operator/lock constraints, exact checked specs or lockfile with no unresolved placeholders, and installed graph/API verification. A newer incompatible published candidate between preflight and application must not change a checked chosen set.

Plans the default consumed launch profile with OTEL_LOGS_EXPORTER=otlp and the discovered same-namespace Studio logs endpoint/protocol alongside trace and metric export. Distinguishes SDK @log GenAI spans, stdout correlation and native application LogRecords. Explicitly identifies the supplied traces/metrics-only and unrequested generated-none cases as missing default log coverage, and the separately supplied three-signal receipt as scoped signal-level evidence requiring actual source/runtime/profile proof for application closure. Requires a real bounded/redacted correlated application LogRecord with the same service resource plus trace/metric receipt, preserved stdout/file sink, owned flush/shutdown and no cloud log forwarding. Honors the separately explicit operator opt-out without using none to make the normal launch or default verification pass; does not attribute independent synthetic records to app.py or claim cloud receipt. Separately records the normal three-signal acceptance versus the operator-opt-out branch: a future local assertion names the resolved profile exporter/endpoint/protocol, actual bounded body/severity/service resource/trace-span correlation plus span and metric datapoints, original local sink retention, owned drain/close and the local-only log boundary. Mere recognition of unrequested none, exporter configuration or native-span/LogRecord difference cannot replace that acceptance receipt or its explicit unrun status. The normal planned application-log record uses actual source-backed body/severity/resource/correlation values or explicit absence reasons, not invented application capture from the synthetic packet. One native OTLP LogRecord per application call and retention of the original discovered local sink are asserted; log-provider/bridge drain/close is distinct from span shutdown. Separately plans an opt-out zero-record branch and a log misconfiguration/failure branch that preserves unrelated traces, metrics and original logging; neither can pass the normal default acceptance. Equivalent explicit assessments across artifacts are accepted.

Names a concrete official SDK example file path plus supplied resolved revision/date and the creator actually exercised there; names additional documented helper imports/schema/signatures/probe provenance separately instead of pretending the logger example exercises the helper. For proposed application-owned helper operations, names the intended application OTel provider registration, supported processor/exporter destination and owned flush/shutdown using the same provider, while actual selected dependency graph/binding/receiver proof stays unproven. For the normal SDK-owned decorator sink, uses its actual supported standalone configuration/source routing rather than an unrelated global provider adapter or private injection. Current helper INTERNAL/no initial-attributes limits, source-side sanitized setters/finalizer checks and one node per operation are preserved.
